summary: Flame Shock + Lava Burst caster spec. Lava Burst is a guaranteed critical strike against a target with Flame Shock applied, so the rotation is built around keeping Flame Shock active.

mechanicalChanges.change: Lightning Bolt / Chain Lightning cast time reduced
mechanicalChanges.detail: Ranks 4-10 of Lightning Bolt cast in 2.5 sec (down from Classic's 3 sec); Chain Lightning rank 1 is a 2 sec cast with a 6 sec cooldown.

mechanicalChanges.change: Fire Nova is now a spell, not a totem
mechanicalChanges.detail: 30 yd range, instant cast, 10 sec cooldown; blasts everything within 10 yd of your Fire totem.
New utility: relocate your totems up to 30 yd away, or recall them instantly.

statPriority.notes: Spell Power is weighted above Hit for Forever's leveling/dungeon content since most targets are near your own level; Hit becomes more important as content tightens around raid-level mob levels.

level20: Keep Flame Shock active on the target at all times
level60: Flame Shock first, and refresh before it drops (Lava Burst deals 20% more to a target with Flame Shock up)
Lava Burst on cooldown as your hardest hitting spell
Lightning Bolt as filler between Flame Shock/Lava Burst (Lightning Overload can trigger a free extra bolt)

keyTalents: Lava Burst (7/2 capstone) — guaranteed crit vs. Flame Shock target
Elemental Devastation — offensive spell crits refresh your melee/ranged crit chance
Lightning Overload — chance for a free second Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning
Call of Flame — buffs Fire totems, Flame Shock, Fire Nova and Searing Totem damage
Elemental Alacrity — reduces cast time of Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst
caveat: Forever is in beta; numbers and talent effects can change with hotfixes. Cross-check against data/shaman.json before publishing hard numbers.
